title: Seven's Creepers
description: A resource pack that revamps the creeper texture while staying faithful to the original design.
body:
A resource pack for Minecraft: Java Edition that revamps the **creeper** while staying faithful to the original design. This pack adds _biome‑based creeper variants_, giving each region i**ts own unique look**!

**_Biome variants included_**:
- Plains
- Taiga
- Snowy biomes
- Jungle
- Swamp
- Badlands
- Desert
- Savanna
- Dark Forest
- Forest
- Birch Forest
- Meadow
- Cherry Grove
- Pale Garden

⚠️**THIS PACK REQUIRES OPTIFINE OR [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) AND [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) TO WORK! BIOME VARIENTS AND EMISSIVE TEXTURES WON'T WORK WITHOUT IT!**⚠️
